remarks: *  * COMING SOON *  *   CORNER END UNIT!  Built in 2022, 14032 Bay St is an upgraded townhouse offering one of the most desirable locations within the community. With its corner end-unit positioning, the home shares less walls than others, while the large living room windows fill the space with natural light and creates a bright, open, and welcoming feel. Tucked into the inner area of the community and away from the main street, the setting feels peaceful and private. Nearly every detail was thoughtfully upgraded giving the home a fresh, modern feel from top to bottom.
